summary: A 62-year-old man was found alone and unresponsive by hikers about ten minutes up the Middle St. Vrain Trail near Camp Dick, off the Peak to Peak Highway; life-saving efforts by BCSO, Allenspark Fire and Estes Park Ambulance were unsuccessful.
location: Middle St. Vrain Trail near Camp Dick
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Allenspark Fire Protection District; Estes Park Ambulance
notes: Rocky Mountain Rescue completed the recovery of the body. Preliminary investigation indicates death by medical-related issues; no foul play. Identity withheld pending family notification.
